name: word-crawler
description: Standalone vocabulary crawler: openly licensed corpus (NGSL/NAWL) -> LLM annotations (Anthropic, Together, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) -> WordCrawler deck JSON with inline /emphasis/ markers. Nothing here is published to npm; the package is consumed by copying a deck file into the main app.

scripts.test: node --test test/corpus.test.ts test/emphasis.test.ts test/annotate.test.ts test/openai.test.ts test/deck.test.ts test/crawl.test.ts test/cli-args.test.ts
